cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.

mechanism: A makes its former adviser pupil distinguish its own wish about A job offer from a polite wish to please A before A discloses the decision.
confusable: Not asking for generic support: A seeks a particular desired outcome before revealing its own chosen stake.
comparison: Political preference guarded from teacher influence versus personal preference about distance.
seedUse: D208 job offer/happiness/why now/unbiased minute; S05 direct-answer practice.
